lines.rom: jaya ahoi mata jaya ahoi mata tumako nisadina dhyavata hara visnu vidhata
brahmani rudrani kamala tu hi hai jaga mata surya candrama dhyavata narada rsi gata
mata rupa niramjana sukha sampatti data jo koi tumako dhyavata nita mamgala pata
tu hi hai patala basanti tu hi hai sukha data karma prabhava prakasaka jaganidhi se trata
